title: VS-101 — Social and Video Source Intelligence Adapters

notes: Adds dedicated YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn public Source Intelligence adapters.
Reuses the VS-99/VS-100 SourceRouter, normalized evidence, cache, provenance and secure HTTP fallback.
No private browser session, user cookie, publishing authority, OAuth scope, frozen UI or scheduler change is authorized.

Product Owner explicitly approved certification after Product Intake, Security baseline, CI, preflight, runtime verification, dashboard build, PostgreSQL 18 migrations and production dependency audit passed for the exact implementation candidate.
Product Owner explicitly approved merge and release after VS-101 certification.
Product Owner explicitly instructed Go, authorizing production enablement and deployment of Batch 3.
